top_signals.title: Oil Falls on Unconfirmed Report That Iran Eased Hormuz Demands
top_signals.summary: Oil fell on an unconfirmed report that Iran had made concessions on its demands over the Strait of Hormuz as diplomatic efforts to end the war in the Middle East continue.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Want to Rent an Internet Address at the White House?
top_signals.summary: Several staffers at the White House are using computers or mobile devices equipped with residential proxy services that render their internet address available for others to rent, security experts warned today. One of the proxy services is a Russian company whose founder's web hosting business was ground zero for cyberattacks against election systems in Arizona and Illinois in 2016.

top_signals.title: British Airways owner warns green charges will ‘kill’ aviation industry and hike fares
top_signals.summary: The chief executive of British Airways’ parent company has said planned environmental charges on airlines would “kill” the European aviation industry and push up fares. Luis Gallego, the chief executive of International Airlines Group (IAG), has warned the proposed green charges – which are more burdensome for UK carriers – would hike prices for passengers [...]

top_signals.title: FBI agent pleads guilty to stealing $2.4 million in crypto from nation-state hackers
top_signals.summary: Patrick Steven Yaroch, 37, is facing up to 20 years in prison on wire fraud and money laundering charges after admitting to using his position on an FBI investigative squad to steal more than $2.4 million in cryptocurrency to cover his debts.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.
